commands.label: Compile the exact progs.src and hello.qc files
commands.stdout:
Mode: progs.src
There are 1 items to compile:
  item: hello.qc (qc)
writing 'progs.dat'

Optimizations:

File statistics:
    dat:
        name: progs.dat
        size: 504 (bytes)
        crc:  0x327B

dedicated-host.py.content_utf8:
import pathlib, re
source = pathlib.Path("exec.cpp")
text = source.read_text()
text, n = re.subn(r"(&qc_stov\s+)(/\*\s*16\s*\*/)",r"\g<1>, \2\n    nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,\n    &qc_print /* Quake server bprint, 23 */",text)
assert n == 1
text, n = re.subn(r'((?:strcmp|strncmp)\([^\n]*?)"main"',r'\1"worldspawn"',text)
assert n == 1
source.write_text(text)

toolchain: GMQCC 0.3.6 Built Nov 19 2026 00:05:06 and its QCVM with Quake server host bindings
reproduction_command: gmqcc && qcvm progs.dat (build QCVM with the recorded dedicated-host.py adapter)
semantic_scope: The native compiler loaded the original progs.src and hello.qc. The upstream VM executed worldspawn from the generated program. The test host bound Quake builtin number 23 to the VM console print implementation and captured the exact broadcast argument.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
